verdict.rationale: SolidJS's source is publicly hosted on GitHub at solidjs/solid, and a community member cites its public commit history (1,823 commits, 1,329 from the creator), so the code is clearly readable. However, nothing in the pack states which license it is released under, so the 'open license' half of the story is unevidenced. Missing for 10: explicit open-source license identification (e.g., MIT/LICENSE file), first-party documentation of licensing terms, independent corroboration of licensing.
